kind: deterministic expense-validation recovery fixture (separate code repair)
not_claimed: Not a retroactive pass of any recorded model attempt.
Not evidence that Qwen or any other model learned these fixes.
Does not change the 22 attempts, the 19 qualifying / 3 rejected split, or the required 21 (still short by 2).
Does not certify the overall goal or unattended production readiness.
files_untouched: all frozen campaign sources, seeds, timeouts, outcomes, reports and GOAL.md

candidate_api.expense_report: csv_text -> dict with keys totals, grand_total, count
candidate_api.io: none (pure functions, no file or network access)
candidate_api.determinism: no randomness, no clock, no globals mutated

contract_checks.name: case_insensitive_grouping
contract_checks.expectation: dict with key Food and value Decimal 3.00

contract_checks.name: missing_amount_cell_raises_value_error
contract_checks.expectation: ValueError raised (any other exception type is a failure)

contract_checks.name: extra_cell_raises_value_error
contract_checks.expectation: ValueError raised (any other exception type is a failure)

opencode_expenses_r1.case_insensitive_grouping: FAIL: two separate groups, result Food=Decimal 1.00 and food=Decimal 2.00

commands.result: no tracked file modified; only new untracked recovery/, tests/test_expense_recovery.py and this evidence file

regression_design.baseline_loading: bytes read read-only; gzip decompressed in memory; compile() in memory; no artifact written
regression_design.control_cases: valid round-trip inputs assert real totals, order, refunds, quoted CSV and report values, so a reject-everything implementation cannot pass
regression_design.exception_contract: a different exception type counts as a failure of the ValueError contract, not a pass

preserved_semantics: quoted CSV fields including commas inside category
non-finite and malformed amounts rejected with ValueError
missing and duplicate headers rejected with ValueError
optional currency column; mixed currencies rejected with ValueError
first spelling and first-appearance order preserved across case-insensitive grouping
report returns totals, grand_total and count of non-blank parsed rows
remaining_limits: This fixture is not wired into the frozen stress campaign and does not alter campaign scores or attempt counts.
Baseline failures are recorded historical facts, not live model behaviour.
Only the three named contract checks plus the extended frozen contract list are covered; unlisted edge cases are out of scope.
The 21-attempt requirement remains short by 2; acceptance remains the commander decision.
